objective: Nested Monte Carlo variance estimator and draw-count controller (Block XV): ANOVA components over param, scenario and world levels; common random numbers for differences; report MC SE per exposed row
implementation_outline: CORRECTED: MC variance of the grand mean is s_M^2/M ALONE (unbiased; the parameter-level means already contain lower-level noise). Variance components for the expand-which-level controller come from expected mean squares: sigma_N^2 = MS_N, sigma_K^2 = (MS_K - MS_N)/N, sigma_M^2 = (MS_M - MS_K)/(K N). Predictive variance and Monte Carlo error are reported as separate quantities. Reference implementation and synthetic validation: nested_mc.py, test_nested_mc.py
acceptance_criteria: G-XV-1 to G-XV-3
validation_plan: synthetic tests with known variance components
blocked_product_scopes: F1 to F5, P1.*, P2, D5, N3
